description: The workspace's prepaid balance for calls on SAGOT numbers (PHP centavos): balance (paid top-ups + SAGOT credits − charges), reserved for calls in progress, available, this month's spend and the optional monthly cap (policy monthlySpendLimitCentavos, null = none), recent top-ups, the proposed rate per country and whether card top-ups are offered. Other line types are not paid from the balance.
